claim: To reject or qualify links, mtgtools now reads three things recorded in KB contracts: the structured object_filter, the trigger's event phrase ("this ... enters" = self trigger) and the words of target-eligibility phrases that name card types. The last two are text fields of the contract, so a downstream module is deriving qualifiers the KB should record structurally. That is the October drift pattern in a small form.
evidence: mtgtools/verbs.py _contracts/_target_types/_self_obs; codex_++/intents/2026-10-27__mtgtools.qualifiers.intent.md; Bandit's Talent op002 has hook_subject 'others' but its event phrase is 'this Class enters'
disposition: bounded interim: only type-line vocabulary words and the 'this' prefix are read, never oracle_text; the fix is for the KB to record target filters and self-subjects as structured qualifiers, then mtgtools drops the phrase reading. Zach decides.
